title: Police Blotter: 17 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Oct. 21-22, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, marijuana possession, family-violence assault, immigration and federal holds, material-witness holds, and parole-violation holds among them. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 21, and Thursday, October 22, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

FRANZUA-PEREZ, TOMAS

FRANZUA-PEREZ, TOMAS was arrested on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 11:06 p.m. (arrest by G4S, per court records) and is being held by the United States Marshals on a material-witness federal hold. No bond had been set at the time of booking.
